comment: MANUAL TAP/PAY: tapping a source that is ALREADY TAPPED is ILLEGAL with the reason "'Kitchen' is already tapped", not a no-op (docs/design/viewer-manual-tap-pay.md). Dropping it instead would be the worst of both worlds -- the line would validate, the {U} would never be produced, and the cast would then be silently dropped at apply time with the human told nothing. It is also the fixture that pins the `taps` AFFORDANCE indirectly: HumanPreTapFaces returns "" for a tapped permanent, which is the same function the decision JSON publishes to the GUI, so a tapped source is un-clickable in the viewer for exactly this reason. Same board as edf_manual_tap_dictates_the_face.json with Kitchen tapped, so the ONLY difference between accept and illegal here is the state of the source.
